findings.title: Cognito identity pool allows unauthenticated identities
findings.description: An identity pool that grants access to unauthenticated users hands AWS credentials to anyone on the internet. Disable allow_unauthenticated_identities unless guest access is intended.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.
